arithmetic_leaf_identity_audit.mapping_metadata_warning: FWHT top-level fft_core=scalar and compute_unit control this online-reorder path. Resolved segment/group_cores=cufftdx-block are generic derived metadata and do not imply cuFFTDx arithmetic execution here. Similarly NTT top-level compute_unit=radix4/hierarchical_core=dataflow-radix4 is not the distinguishing subgraph leaf identity.
arithmetic_leaf_identity_audit.measurement_limit: Current endpoint run collected resolved mappings and source-selected stage resource descriptions, not demangled profiler kernel names. Source dispatch, compiler-resource differences (radix2 prefix17 registers versus radix4 prefix23 at t128/c1), and historical NTT kernel names corroborate identity; no new trace or disassembly was performed.
arithmetic_leaf_identity_audit.ntt_verdict: The NTT leaves are genuinely different implementations: homogeneous-radix4 uses shared-memory CTA radix4 local subgraphs; homogeneous-warp-radix2 uses warp-register stage updates via hierarchical_warp_register_subgraph/appt_apply_cached_register_stage. Both use the same Shoup modular arithmetic contract and in-repository code.
arithmetic_leaf_identity_audit.verdict: FWHT radix2/radix4 fields select distinct compiled template specializations; the field is consumed. They share the same elementary scalar FP32 a+b/a-b operation and preserve the same Sylvester add/sub dependency tree. Radix4 fuses two consecutive stages into one register-held four-value codelet and one shared-memory synchronization per pair. These are in-repository arithmetic/synchronization variants, not cores imported from different external libraries.
arithmetic_leaf_identity_audit.zero_error_interpretation: Bitwise equality to the FP32 reference is consistent with the unchanged stage-wise FP32 add/sub tree. Different grouping, intermediate residence and synchronization do not require different numerical results; zero error alone neither proves nor disproves a distinct code path.
